payload.name: Photo 420x560 Under 200KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 420 x 560 photo workflow for 200KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 420 x 560 photo under 200KB workflow for application, school, profile, marketplace, and admin upload forms that require exact portrait pixels plus a 200KB cap. It points to local resize and image-to-KB compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
